publication_cluster_uncertainty.method: Paired nonparametric publication cluster percentile bootstrap; whole papers sampled with replacement, all their candidate rows retained.
publication_cluster_uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive uncertainty across benchmark publications, not independent candidate-row intervals or a whole-Pharos accuracy guarantee. Cross-publication entity/evidence reuse can remain.

report.comparison_interpretation: Published specialist source-relation extraction against weak co-mention/type controls, not a measured gain over the original Pharos graph.
report.label_scope: Expert abstract-relative native BioRED annotations; None is no qualifying relation in that abstract, not biological irrelevance.
report.sampling_scope: Complete eligible native gene-pair benchmark, weighted by candidate rows. The primary agent assessment instead has one pair per publication; their point estimates have different denominators.
report.uncertainty_scope: Correlated candidate rows are not counted as independent publication replicates. No whole-Pharos population confidence interval is inferred.
reference_limitations: Gold entity spans/IDs are supplied; entity detection and canonical human-protein grounding are not tested.
Public model/pretraining/checkpoint exposure cannot be fully independently audited.
Native Bind is preserved as a corpus category and is not automatically direct physical binding.
No additional language-model arm or automatic graph acceptance/pruning was introduced.

report.interpretation: Author-intended BC8 reference-agreement reproduction diagnostic. One released checkpoint versus paper seed means is not an exact numerical reproduction or a test of fine-tuning independence.
report.scope: All author processed candidate rows; one of the400 source abstracts has no processed candidate row. Gold entities supplied; no end-to-end NER or canonical human-protein mapping evaluation.
report.decoding: Unchanged native convert_to_biored_label saved outputs; author load_gold_labels and eval helpers used for all six metric levels. No alternate threshold or synthetic score vector.
